Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding protecting legally existing uses from new regulations adopted under chapter 36.70A RCW.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to protecting legally existing uses from newregulations adopted under chapter 36.70A RCW; and adding a new sectionto chapter 36.70A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.70A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Regulations adopted under this chapter may not prohibit useslegally existing on any parcel prior to their adoption.
